summary: Laboratory confirmed pressure between stainless-steel walls below atmospheric pressure; treated as a vacuum vessel.
Laboratory found a double-wall stainless tumbler was not insulated by vacuum; treated as stainless household ware.
Laboratory found no vacuum properties in a double-wall stainless tumbler.
Distinguished an ornamental polyresin acorn from a utilitarian polyresin planter.
HDPE planters designed as garden equipment were treated as other household articles of plastics.
Polyresin gnome statuettes were treated as other ornamental articles of plastics.
Explains that heading 3924 household articles must share a household function with the heading's exemplars; residual plastic articles fall in heading 3926 when not covered more specifically.
Porcelain mugs were treated as mugs and other steins of porcelain or china.
Dolomite earthenware ceramic mugs were treated as mugs other than of porcelain or china.
